open.name: Multi-Unit Residential Building Retrofit Program
open.who: Purpose-built market rental, condominium and equity co-op buildings of three storeys or more, with common-area lighting and central mechanical systems, on an active BC Hydro or City of New Westminster account.
funds: Opportunity assessment — up to $5,000 per site
Feasibility study — up to $30,000 per site
Heat pumps and heat pump water heaters, central or in-suite, for buildings heated by gas, oil or propane as well as electrically heated ones
Make-up air units, and the electrical capacity upgrade a fuel switch needs
Variable speed drives, parkade carbon monoxide controls, common-area LED lighting and controls
open.excluded: New construction, commercial space in a mixed-use building, and smaller buildings such as multiplexes and side-by-side rowhomes.
open.role: We quote the mechanical scope, size the equipment, supply the specifications the application asks for, and install.

open.name: Social Housing Energy Savings Program
open.who: Non-profit housing societies, housing co-ops, local and provincial housing authorities, registered charities operating social housing, and Indigenous governing bodies. Funding is first come, first served against the programme budget.
funds: Opportunity assessment — up to $6,000 per site
Feasibility study — up to $40,000 per site
Energy efficiency equipment — up to $600,000 per site
Fuel switching equipment — up to $400,000 per site
Behind-the-meter electrical upgrades a fuel switch requires — up to $400,000 per site
Implementation support — up to $11,000 per site
open.excluded: Individual tenants cannot apply, and single, semi-detached, row and duplex houses are not eligible unless they share HVAC systems.
open.role: Same as above, plus the invoices and equipment data the claim needs at the end.

closed.name: CleanBC Custom and Custom-Lite
closed.note: Not currently accepting new applications. These were the route for commercial, industrial and multi-unit buildings — energy studies, heat pump rooftop units and other capital upgrades — and more than 350 funded projects are underway or complete.

closed.name: CleanBC Commercial Express
closed.note: Not currently accepting new applications. It funded commercial upgrades that cut greenhouse gas emissions, up to $100,000 per project, and more than 60 funded projects are underway or complete.
